scope: Package 2 Step P — asynchronous job persistence, ownership, leases, bounded retries, terminal failure retention and reconciliation.

durableDomains.knownGap: Publisher transaction atomicity/order/restart behavior requires final database test.

durableDomains.invariant: Unique notificationId+attemptNumber; no provider delivery is claimed solely from UI state.

durableDomains.ownership: Claimed item is bound to gatewayId/deviceId; finalization must match that owner. Existing lease is bounded by 30–3600 seconds (default 300).

durableDomains.invariant: Payload is encrypted at rest within provider state; POST uses resultId as Idempotency-Key; retries use bounded backoff and a configured max attempt count.
Command delivery is distinct from handset execution/ACK; identity, signature, expiry and approvals are validated by separate command/Gateway paths.

durableDomains.knownGap: Schema represents a reviewed job record; a dedicated durable executor/lease/recovery path is not established in the current source package.

retryOutboxBehavior.invalidEncryptedPayload: Dead-letter immediately; deterministic parse/decryption failures must not be retried endlessly.
retryOutboxBehavior.maxAttemptsReached: Retain encrypted outbox item with safe lastError and deadLetteredAt; do not silently delete undelivered work.
retryOutboxBehavior.legacyRecords: Missing status is backward-compatible and treated as READY. A dead-letter record is not automatically retried; manual repair/replay policy remains pending.

currentCandidates: SQLite single state row with transaction
PostgreSQL JSONB state row with SELECT FOR UPDATE
storageSelection.multiInstanceClaimSafety: NOT_PROVEN for JSON/SQLite; PostgreSQL row updates serialize one provider-state row but deployment-scale behavior needs tests.
storageSelection.policy: Do not change provider storage driver or migrate persisted provider data automatically during this step.

controls.title: Durable owner
controls.required: Every queued work domain identifies one owning service and persisted state source.

controls.title: Gateway queue ownership
controls.required: Gateway claims and finalization are scoped to the assigned gateway/device identity.

controls.title: Lease expiry
controls.required: SMS/call queue claims use finite lease timestamps and claim eligibility checks lease expiry.

controls.title: Retry schedule
controls.required: Queue/outbox retries have next-attempt timestamps and bounded backoff/max attempts.

controls.title: Backend idempotency
controls.required: Provider result POST uses a stable resultId Idempotency-Key so an uncertain response can be retried safely at the API boundary.

controls.title: Encrypted result queue
controls.required: Provider backend-result payload is encrypted before it is persisted in provider state.

controls.title: Dead-letter retention
controls.required: Invalid encrypted/schema payloads and retry-exhausted remote deliveries retain a DEAD_LETTER record with a safe error code and timestamp.

controls.title: No false success
controls.required: Backend result is acknowledged only after a successful HTTP response; queued/delivered command state is not equal to handset execution success.

controls.title: No auto-replay of dead letter
controls.required: Dead-letter work is not sent automatically again without an explicit replay/reset policy.

controls.title: Storage ambiguity visible
controls.required: JSON, SQLite and PostgreSQL driver candidates remain disclosed; no exactly-once or cross-process claim without atomic-claim proof.

controls.title: Unimplemented executor visible
controls.required: DataMergeJob has a schema record but no established worker/lease path in this source package; do not report it as executing durable work.

controls.title: Physical tests deferred
controls.required: Crash/restart, competing worker, lease expiry, poison payload and idempotent replay tests remain NOT_RUN until all four packages finish.

finalPhysicalTests: Provider state survives process restart for the selected approved persistence driver.
Two workers cannot claim the same queue item concurrently on production-selected storage.
Expired lease is safely reclaimed while an unexpired lease is not duplicated.
Wrong Gateway/device cannot finalize a claimed SMS/call item.
Backend result outbox retries after timeout with stable Idempotency-Key and no duplicate Backend side effect.
Invalid encrypted/JSON payload is retained as DEAD_LETTER with safe error metadata.
Retry exhaustion retains the outbox record and linked delivery result remains unacknowledged.
A successful Backend result response marks delivery result ACKed and removes READY retry item.
Dead-letter queue is visible to authorized operational review and is not auto-replayed.
Provider storage driver migration between JSON/SQLite/PostgreSQL cannot lose or split authoritative state.
Realtime outbox work resumes after Backend restart and preserves actor audience/order.
Notification attempts are unique by notificationId and attemptNumber.
Gateway command delivered state is distinct from command execution/ACK result.
DataMergeJob has an explicitly approved executor or remains clearly non-executable/manual-only.
knownResidualsRequiringFinalReview: Approve exactly one authoritative Provider storage driver and migration procedure.
Decide cross-process lease/claim algorithm and worker concurrency limits.
Define authorized manual DEAD_LETTER inspect/replay/reset controls and retention policy.
DataMergeJob has no proven durable worker/lease implementation in the current source package.
Remote callback delivery is at-least-once; real backend idempotency semantics must be tested.
Provider JSON/SQLite whole-state updates and multi-process locking safety remain unproven.
